symbols.name: source chunk
symbols.meaning: The address chunk whose selected bits are XORed into y.
symbols.quote: Packed selected-bit addition XORs chosen bits of a chunk $x$ into chunk $y$ (chunks here), restoring a scratch chunk $z$; the [simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-layer.md) on $d$ address chunks needs it.

symbols.name: target chunk
symbols.meaning: The address chunk that receives the XORs (not the ring variable).
symbols.quote: Packed selected-bit addition XORs chosen bits of a chunk $x$ into chunk $y$ (chunks here), restoring a scratch chunk $z$; the [simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-layer.md) on $d$ address chunks needs it.

symbols.name: scratch chunk
symbols.meaning: The third address chunk, used as scratch and restored.
symbols.quote: Packed selected-bit addition XORs chosen bits of a chunk $x$ into chunk $y$ (chunks here), restoring a scratch chunk $z$; the [simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-layer.md) on $d$ address chunks needs it.

symbols.name: chunk count
symbols.meaning: The number of address chunks the butterfly layer acts on.
symbols.quote: Packed selected-bit addition XORs chosen bits of a chunk $x$ into chunk $y$ (chunks here), restoring a scratch chunk $z$; the [simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-layer.md) on $d$ address chunks needs it.

symbols.name: record bits
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in a record (not the scalar ring).
symbols.quote: Records have $R$ bits.

symbols.name: chunk bits
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in an address chunk, L=fK.
symbols.quote: A chunk has $L=fK$ bits (segment length $K\ge6$); the $f$ selected bits lie at $j_i=\rho+iK$, $0\le i<f$, with offset $\rho<K$; the goal is $y_{j_i}\leftarrow y_{j_i}\oplus x_{j_i}$.

symbols.name: segment length
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in a segment, and the spacing of selected positions.
symbols.quote: A chunk has $L=fK$ bits (segment length $K\ge6$); the $f$ selected bits lie at $j_i=\rho+iK$, $0\le i<f$, with offset $\rho<K$; the goal is $y_{j_i}\leftarrow y_{j_i}\oplus x_{j_i}$.

symbols.name: selected bits
symbols.meaning: The number of selected bit positions in a chunk.
symbols.quote: A chunk has $L=fK$ bits (segment length $K\ge6$); the $f$ selected bits lie at $j_i=\rho+iK$, $0\le i<f$, with offset $\rho<K$; the goal is $y_{j_i}\leftarrow y_{j_i}\oplus x_{j_i}$.

symbols.name: offset
symbols.meaning: The position of the lowest selected bit, 0 <= rho < K.
symbols.quote: A chunk has $L=fK$ bits (segment length $K\ge6$); the $f$ selected bits lie at $j_i=\rho+iK$, $0\le i<f$, with offset $\rho<K$; the goal is $y_{j_i}\leftarrow y_{j_i}\oplus x_{j_i}$.

symbols.name: selected position
symbols.meaning: The position j_i = rho + iK of the i-th selected bit.
symbols.quote: A chunk has $L=fK$ bits (segment length $K\ge6$); the $f$ selected bits lie at $j_i=\rho+iK$, $0\le i<f$, with offset $\rho<K$; the goal is $y_{j_i}\leftarrow y_{j_i}\oplus x_{j_i}$.

symbols.name: address count
symbols.meaning: The number of addresses.
symbols.quote: Let $M$ count addresses, $V=MR$, and $A_{\rm rect}=\lceil\log_2(2V)\rceil$ bound counter lengths.

symbols.name: volume
symbols.meaning: The number of bits stored, MR.
symbols.quote: Let $M$ count addresses, $V=MR$, and $A_{\rm rect}=\lceil\log_2(2V)\rceil$ bound counter lengths.

symbols.name: counter length
symbols.meaning: The bit length of counters, ceil(log2(2V)).
symbols.quote: Let $M$ count addresses, $V=MR$, and $A_{\rm rect}=\lceil\log_2(2V)\rceil$ bound counter lengths.

symbols.name: control
symbols.meaning: A Boolean control.
symbols.quote: For a Boolean control $c$ and integers $u,w$, $c[P]$ is $c$ if $P$ holds, else $0$.

symbols.name: first integer
symbols.meaning: The integer on which the parity-conditioned additions act first (a segment of y).
symbols.quote: For a Boolean control $c$ and integers $u,w$, $c[P]$ is $c$ if $P$ holds, else $0$.

symbols.name: second integer
symbols.meaning: The auxiliary integer to be restored (a segment of z).
symbols.quote: For a Boolean control $c$ and integers $u,w$, $c[P]$ is $c$ if $P$ holds, else $0$.

symbols.name: guard of y
symbols.meaning: The segment value of y divided by two, rounded down.
symbols.quote: For $0\le i<f-1$, the $K$ bits of $y$ from $j_i$ give a segment $u_i=2g_i+a_i$ and those of $z$ give $w_i=2h_i+b_i$, with bits $a_i,b_i$, guard values $g_i,h_i\in\{0,\dots,2^{K-1}-1\}$, and control $c_i=x_{j_i}$.

symbols.name: guard of z
symbols.meaning: The segment value of z divided by two, rounded down.
symbols.quote: For $0\le i<f-1$, the $K$ bits of $y$ from $j_i$ give a segment $u_i=2g_i+a_i$ and those of $z$ give $w_i=2h_i+b_i$, with bits $a_i,b_i$, guard values $g_i,h_i\in\{0,\dots,2^{K-1}-1\}$, and control $c_i=x_{j_i}$.

symbols.name: low bit of y
symbols.meaning: The lowest bit of the i-th segment of y.
symbols.quote: For $0\le i<f-1$, the $K$ bits of $y$ from $j_i$ give a segment $u_i=2g_i+a_i$ and those of $z$ give $w_i=2h_i+b_i$, with bits $a_i,b_i$, guard values $g_i,h_i\in\{0,\dots,2^{K-1}-1\}$, and control $c_i=x_{j_i}$.

symbols.name: low bit of z
symbols.meaning: The lowest bit of the i-th segment of z.
symbols.quote: For $0\le i<f-1$, the $K$ bits of $y$ from $j_i$ give a segment $u_i=2g_i+a_i$ and those of $z$ give $w_i=2h_i+b_i$, with bits $a_i,b_i$, guard values $g_i,h_i\in\{0,\dots,2^{K-1}-1\}$, and control $c_i=x_{j_i}$.

symbols.name: segment control
symbols.meaning: The selected bit of x at j_i, controlling the i-th segment pair.
symbols.quote: For $0\le i<f-1$, the $K$ bits of $y$ from $j_i$ give a segment $u_i=2g_i+a_i$ and those of $z$ give $w_i=2h_i+b_i$, with bits $a_i,b_i$, guard values $g_i,h_i\in\{0,\dots,2^{K-1}-1\}$, and control $c_i=x_{j_i}$.

symbols.name: packed map
symbols.meaning: The composition of the eight packed cyclic shifts.
symbols.quote: Each is a cyclic shift of a whole chunk by an offset independent of the target chunk, hence a bijection of the addresses; $S_0$ composes the eight.

symbols.name: exceptional set
symbols.meaning: The addresses where some guard of y or z lies outside [10, 2^{K-1}-11].
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal B$ (exceptional addresses) be those where a guard of $y$ or $z$ fails $10\le g\le2^{K-1}-11$.

symbols.name: ideal map
symbols.meaning: The permutation that performs the required XORs at j_0..j_{f-2}.
symbols.quote: Off $\mathcal B$ each segment lies in $[20,2^K-21]$, so displacement eight stays in $[0,2^K-1]$: no segment carries into or borrows from a neighbour, and $S_0$ equals the ideal map $T_0$ XORing at $j_0,\dots,j_{f-2}$.

symbols.name: bad fraction
symbols.meaning: The bound min{1, 80(f-1)2^{-K}} on the fraction of exceptional addresses.
symbols.quote: Guards are equidistributed at every spectator choice, so a union bound over $2(f-1)$ guards gives $|\mathcal B|\le\delta_{\rm bad}M$ with $\delta_{\rm bad}=\min\{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}\}$.

symbols.name: swap exponent
symbols.meaning: The fixed exponent below 1 in the chunk interchange cost.
symbols.quote: It performs rotations as [controlled shifts](controlled-shifts.md) costing $O(V)$ and swaps as [chunk interchanges](address-interchange.md) costing $O(VL^\tau)$ for fixed exponent $\tau<1$.

symbols.name: precision
symbols.meaning: The number of precision bits of the records.
symbols.quote: With $p$ the precision bits, both vanish when $A_{\rm rect}=O(p)$, $R$ exceeds every polynomial in $p$, $f\le d\le p$ and $K/\log p\to\infty$, so the cost is $O(V(L^\tau+1))$.

$T_0$ flips only the bits $a_i$, preserving guards and so $\mathcal B$. Two bijections agreeing off $\mathcal B$ give $S_0(\mathcal B^c)=T_0(\mathcal B^c)=\mathcal B^c$ and $S_0(\mathcal B)=\mathcal B$, so $T_0S_0^{-1}$ fixes $\mathcal B^c$ and permutes $\mathcal B$.
$S_0$ has at most eight rotations and sixteen swaps

A scan extracts records at $\mathcal B$, computing each destination $T_0S_0^{-1}$ by reversing the eight additions; its rank (current rank plus signed chunk differences times strides) is the key, and its hole is marked. As $T_0S_0^{-1}$ permutes $\mathcal B$, the keys are exactly the holes' ranks, so a stable radix sort and one scan refilling holes in order apply $T_0$.
Schoolbook arithmetic on counters costs $O(A_{\rm rect}^3)$ per record; at most $A_{\rm rect}$ radix passes sort $|\mathcal B|$ records of $R+A_{\rm rect}$ bits.

Per $V$ the extra terms are $A_{\rm rect}^3/R$ and $80(f-1)2^{-K}A_{\rm rect}(1+A_{\rm rect}/R)$. With $p$ the precision bits, both vanish when $A_{\rm rect}=O(p)$, $R$ exceeds every polynomial in $p$, $f\le d\le p$ and $K/\log p\to\infty$, so the cost is $O(V(L^\tau+1))$.
